name: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth (Total Conversion)
author: Experimental Showcase
tagline: Experimental v0.15 total conversion showcase: 55 characters, 45 enemies, 8 Isaac chapters, 40 items, 71 synergies, and 38 custom mechanics.
description: An experimental proof of concept and showcase of custom mechanics and total conversions in PokeBonk. Replaces core game assets, UI, and event themes with The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth while remaining a togglable mod (overrides other active mods except Hyrule's Collection). Features: 55 playable characters and bosses, 45 custom enemies, 8 multi-room Isaac chapters with locked doors, bombs, secret rooms, and void pits, Isaac-themed Expedition/Tower/Boss Rush maps, 40 custom items, 61 custom attacks, 71 synergies, 38 interactive map mechanics, an Isaac HUD with hearts and a fog-of-war minimap, 63 custom 3D models, 20 music tracks, and 114 sound effects.
highlights: 55 playable characters and bosses with Wiki-inspired movesets (only Isaac starts unlocked; rest unlock through play or via the Unlock All setting)
45 custom dungeon enemies and Isaac-themed Expedition, Tower, and Boss Rush maps (keeping vanilla event generation)
8 Isaac chapters with multi-shape rooms, combat/key/coin/curse locked doors, bombs [B] for secret rooms, void pits, and interactive landmarks
40 custom items, 61 custom attacks, 71 synergies, and 18 completion mark achievements
38 interactive map mechanics (shops, slot machines, beggars, sacrifice spikes, exploding barrels, breakable poop, fireplaces, etc.)
Isaac HUD with heart containers, pickups, active items [F], tarot cards/pills [Q], fog-of-war minimap, 63 custom 3D models, 20 music tracks, and 114 SFX
requirements: Offline Mode (Mod Engine ON) -- Total Conversion (Compatible with Hyrule's Collection)
